problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Component Alpha: mass 48 tons
* Component Beta: mass 30 tons
* Component Gamma: mass 57 tons
* Component Delta: mass 47 tons
* Component Epsilon: mass 46 tons
* Component Zeta: mass 64 tons
* Component Eta: mass 63 tons
* Component Theta: mass 65 tons
* Component Iota: mass 50 tons
* Component Kappa: mass 51 tons
* Component Lambda: mass 42 tons
* Component Mu: mass 57 tons
* Component Nu: mass 39 tons
* Component Xi: mass 30 tons
* Component Omicron: mass 62 tons
* Component Pi: mass 39 tons
* Component Rho: mass 66 tons
* Component Sigma: mass 54 tons
* Component Tau: mass 53 tons

Each aircraft has a maximum payload capacity of 100 tons. All shipments must be transported, with each shipment loaded onto exactly one aircraft, and the combined mass on any aircraft must not surpass its capacity. Determine an assignment that minimizes the total number of aircraft required.
